mintAuthority.summary: EURCV Ethereum mint is restricted to SG-FORGE's immutable registrar EOA. The token is a UUPS SmartCoin V4 proxy: the immutable technical EOA executes upgrades only after the registrar has authorized the candidate implementation; there is no separate proxy-admin slot.

review.evidence: Historical Ethereum control observations remain at block 25530438, with subsequent controller observations recorded separately above; XRPL, Stellar, Solana and Canton authorities are not certified by this Ethereum control inventory. Reconciliation research on 2026-10-03 re-opened the September 30, 2026 EURCV whitepaper and issuer daily dashboard. D.10 requires the issuer to obtain collateral-custodian information daily, calculate aggregate eligible collateral value on every Business Day, and compare it to the quantity of all EURCV outstanding multiplied by one euro. C.2 expressly aggregates Ethereum, Solana, XRPL, Stellar and Canton issuance. D.10 requires publication of collateral composition, value, required value and the test result on the following Business Day. The dashboard labels its matching outstanding EURCV and reserve amount 167,013,839.02 as Last update 2/10/2026 in the Internet Archive capture of 2026-10-02T20:00Z; the 3/10 date previously recorded here is not supported by that capture and is corrected. Series re-check 2026-10-21: raw archive captures of the issuer page show Last update 26/09/2026 (167,781,048.22), 30/09/2026 (164,388,393.02) and 2/10/2026 (167,013,839.02), and the live page on 2026-10-21 shows Last update 21/10/2026 (169,091,433.55, 100% Societe Generale). White paper C.2 states 164,388,393 aggregated across Ethereum, Solana, XRPL, Stellar and Canton as of the 2026-09-30 publication date, matching the 30/09 dashboard, so the aggregate perimeter is the whole outstanding supply on every listed ledger. The 30/09 and 2/10 captures each show the one-Business-Day publication lag D.10 requires, and the amount changes between them, so this is a recurring dated series rather than a single snapshot. This supersedes the 2026-10-21 FU-EURCV withdrawal, whose series element was based on not having retrieved these captures; the D.10 test definition, the one-business-day lag and the absence of an independent examiner are unchanged. This establishes an issuer-operated periodic whole-supply-to-reserve procedure and a matching current observation, not independent assurance, continuous intraday reconciliation or audited mint-controller operation. SG-FORGE remains the ACPR-authorised EMI issuer; no new authority, cap or incident-free claim is made by this reconciliation-only research.
